capabilities: Preview and publish single or batch notes to GitHub
Upload referenced local images and set Fluid cover and banner images
Choose existing Hexo categories and target folders
Check local publishing status and GitHub Actions deployment
Withdraw published articles and merge publishing conflicts
disambiguation: Not a general note-sync or vault-bridging tool; it only publishes notes to a Hexo repository.
extras: Manual install from release files (manifest.json, main.js, styles.css); requires Obsidian 1.11.4+; token kept in Obsidian SecretStorage; no telemetry; every GitHub write needs explicit confirmation; further documentation is linked externally.
problem: Moving notes and their images from Obsidian into a Hexo blog means manual conversion, uploads and Git commits, with no way to check status or recover from conflicts.

relations.evidence: publishes Markdown notes and referenced images to a Hexo source repository through GitHub
uses api.github.com to read the configured repository, branch, and Actions status

summary: Publishes selected notes and referenced images to a Hexo source repository via GitHub, with previews, covers, categories and deployment checks.
